newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB to be represented on Rashid board.
newsitem.headline: MRCB to be represented on Rashid board.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) will have representation on the board of stockbroker Rashid Hussain Bhd due to MRCB's nearly 30 percent stake in the company, Rashid Hussain said on Tuesday.

"We intend to include them on the board," said Abdul Rashid Hussain, executive chairman of the firm bearing his name at a news conference to announce a deal to buy 75 percent of Kwong Yik Bank Bhd from Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) for 2.16 billion ringgit.
He did not say how many seats MRCB would be given.
But he said construction and property concern MRCB has publicly said it will not interfere with the running of Rashid's stockbrokerage or banking operations.

MRCB already owns about 20.06 percent of Rashid's equity. It will get a larger position under a Rashid plan to sell 10 percent of new shares of its stock to MRCB to partly refinance the purchase of the Kwong Yik stock.
Asked if MRCB would be involved in helping Rashid manage its property businesses, Abdul Rashid said: "When it involves property, we would certainly welcome MRCB's experience."
He added: "In our meeting (with MRCB), it was understood the management of financial (operations) would be left to me."
